description: One recorded modification of a session file, attributed to a prompt through the pinned Claude session (m0026). The payload capture set is one typed column per field, never a blob, so every axis is queryable; (tool_use_id, session_file_uuid) is partial-UNIQUE so a replayed payload produces one row
name: File Change

properties.description: The file this change belongs to
properties.name: Session File

properties.description: Prompt attribution, resolved from the claude_session_binding for a hook write; drives implementation-state comparison
properties.name: Prompt

properties.description: Writing agent's opaque id, stamped from the payload; its ABSENCE is the primary/subagent discriminator
properties.name: Agent Id

properties.description: Stamped SERVER-SIDE from the attributed prompt's active bot_workflow — the writer cannot mis-stamp
properties.name: Workflow Phase

properties.description: hook|manual|command (default hook): a command-derived inference never passes for an exact structuredPatch row
properties.name: Origin

properties.description: The conversation that produced this change; denormalized so attribution is queryable without the binding join
properties.name: Claude Session Id

properties.description: Claude Code's TURN id (payload field: prompt_id). NEVER a gmcc prompt uuid — named for what it holds
properties.name: Claude Turn Id

properties.description: The tool call — idempotency key, partial-UNIQUE with session_file_uuid because one Bash call writes N files
properties.name: Tool Use Id

properties.description: Which tool wrote it (Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, Bash)
properties.name: Tool Name

properties.description: The payload's agent_type label for the writer; overloaded by spawn shape, so authority lives on agent_registration
properties.name: Agent Type

properties.description: The permission mode in force for the tool call
properties.name: Permission Mode

properties.description: How long the tool call took. Data only — never an mtime window, which misattributes under parallel fan-out
properties.name: Duration Ms

properties.description: The transcript the tool call belongs to; the row is self-describing without the harness
properties.name: Transcript Path

properties.description: The identity that made this change. NULL IS FORCED for a primary write: the primary carries no agent_id to point at
properties.name: Agent Registration
